name: AARES 2027 - 71st Annual Conference
organizer: Australasian Agricultural and Resource Economics Society (AARES)
venue: Rydges Melbourne (pre-conference workshops at La Trobe University City Campus)
conf_dates_note: Pre-conference workshops 2 Feb 2027; contributed papers and special sessions 3-5 Feb 2027. Theme: "Seven Decades of Agriculture and Resource Economics: Lessons, Legacy and Futures".
call_type: Contributed papers, posters, special sessions and pre-conference workshops
deadline_note: Conference site: submissions accepted 1 July-23 August 2026 and "the call has now closed". The July 2026 AARES newsletter had given Sunday 9 August 2026.
